cert.title: An agent certificate isn't renewing
cert.body: {{node}} on {{env}}: the certificate expires {{when}}. Check that the agent can reach Bayplan.
cert.bodyExpired: {{node}} on {{env}}: the certificate expired {{when}}. Check that the agent can reach Bayplan.

manualUpdate.body: Auto-update is off or the agent is outside the compatibility window.

clock.title: The clock is off on {{node}}
clock.body: {{node}} on {{env}} is {{offset}} out of step. Bayplan refuses agents beyond 5 minutes.

pending.title: {{name}} still has no agent
pending.body_one: It was added {{count}} day ago. Finish installing the agent or remove it.
pending.body_other: It was added {{count}} days ago. Finish installing the agent or remove it.

clusterChanged.title: {{name}} was re-initialised
clusterChanged.body: Adopt the new cluster or remove the environment.

fold.title: This host is part of {{swarm}}
fold.body: Fold it into the swarm environment so it isn't listed twice.

refusalBurst.description: {{user}} was refused {{count}} times in the last minute. Look at the audit log.

untrustedForwarded.title: Forwarded headers from an untrusted address
untrustedForwarded.body: Bayplan got X-Forwarded headers from {{ip}}, which isn't in BAYPLAN_TRUSTED_PROXIES. They were ignored.

urlMismatch.title: Requests don't match the public URL
urlMismatch.body: Requests arrive for {{host}} over {{scheme}}, but the public URL is {{url}}. Sign-in and agent connections may fail.

webSocketFailing.title: WebSocket connections are failing
webSocketFailing.body: Agents or terminals can't connect through your proxy. Check that it passes the Upgrade headers.

expiring.description: {{scope}} credential for {{host}}. Pulls that use it fail after that.
expiring.descriptionMany: Pulls that use them fail after that.

expired.title: “{{name}}” has expired
expired.description: {{scope}} credential for {{host}}. Pulls that use it are being refused.
expired.descriptionMany: Pulls that use them are being refused.

auth_failed.title: “{{name}}” was refused by {{host}}
auth_failed.description: Its last use failed {{time}}. Check its token or test it.
auth_failed.descriptionMany: Their last use failed. Check their tokens or test them.
